title: Policy Insights: A membership for purpose-driven organisations
gist: A sales page (not an article) for Prospect's Policy Insights membership, which sells think tanks, universities, businesses and advocacy groups guaranteed editorial-adjacent coverage across the magazine's website, newsletters and social channels to reach policymakers; disclosed partners are OEUK, Trussell and BT.

themes.theme: Paid policy influence as a media business line

insights.claim: Prospect operates a paid membership platform that sells organisations guaranteed digital coverage across its website, newsletters and social channels explicitly as a route to shaping the policy agenda and reaching policymakers.
insights.speaker: Prospect Magazine
insights.so_what: Some 'policy commentary' in UK ideas media is purchased placement — discount unattributed policy pieces when reading UK regulatory sentiment.
insights.quote: membership offers guaranteed digital coverage across Prospect’s website, newsletters and social channels
insights.locator: Whether you're a think tank, academic institution

insights.claim: The pitch sells the publisher's trusted editorial reputation and progressive outlook as the mechanism that makes a paying member's voice influential rather than merely visible, monetising editorial credibility directly.
insights.speaker: Prospect Magazine
insights.so_what: Credibility-as-a-product is the emerging revenue model for subscale political media — and a structural conflict-of-interest risk to price in.
insights.quote: Policy Insights ensures your voice is not only visible, but influential

insights.claim: Named Policy Insights partners are OEUK, Trussell and BT, putting an offshore-energy body, a charity and a telecoms incumbent in the same paid-influence channel aimed at UK policymakers.
insights.speaker: Prospect Magazine
insights.so_what: Identifies which UK sectors are actively buying policy narrative capacity — offshore energy and telecoms are lobbying hardest for framing.

insights.claim: The most popular article associated with this commercial channel is titled Building the future of the North Sea, indicating offshore energy is the flagship sponsored-policy theme.
insights.speaker: Prospect Magazine
insights.so_what: North Sea licensing and transition framing is being actively contested via paid media — a tell that policy is still in play, not settled.
insights.quote: Building the future of the North Sea
insights.locator: Popular articles / Building the future of the North Sea
